title: Sidharth Kumar Pandey v. Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Anjani Kumar Mishra, J.; Jayant Banerji, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; representation to be decided within three weeks.
headnote: Writ challenging a 9 May 2024 bill and a load rise from 4 KW to 10 KW, said to breach clause 6.9 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and seeking conversion from LMV-2 to LMV-1 under clause 3.3, was disposed of. Respondent no. 2 must decide the representation dated 10 October 2024 expeditiously, preferably within three weeks of a certified copy being filed.
facts: Sidharth Kumar Pandey and another, consumers of Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd., complained that between 9 April and 9 May 2024 the licensee raised their load from 4 KW to 10 KW and issued a bill dated 9 May 2024 without complying with clause 6.9 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. They also asked that the connection be changed from LMV-2 to LMV-1 under clause 3.3. By the hearing they had already filed a representation dated 10 October 2024.

holding_units.topic: Time-bound decision of representation against load enhancement and bill
holding_units.holding: Where a representation dated 10 October 2024 is already pending against enhancement of load from 4 KW to 10 KW and a bill dated 9 May 2024 alleged to breach clause 6.9, the writ is disposed of by directing respondent no. 2 to decide that representation expeditiously, preferably within three weeks of a certified copy being filed. The Court does not quash the bill or order conversion of the connection.

principle_tags.application: The Court left the clause 6.9 grievance to the representation already filed on 10 October 2024 and directed respondent no. 2 to decide it preferably within three weeks of receiving a certified copy.

not_decided.point: Whether the bill dated 9 May 2024 and the enhancement of load from 4 KW to 10 KW between 9 April 2024 and 9 May 2024 violated clause 6.9.
not_decided.note: Left to respondent no. 2 on the representation dated 10 October 2024.

not_decided.point: Whether the connection must be converted from LMV-2 to LMV-1 under clause 3.3.
not_decided.note: The mandamus was not granted; the request remains with the pending representation.
